goals.goal: When a natural person (business customer or end-user of a customer) submits a data-subject rights request (Art. 15–22) to TinyTask as controller, the identity of the requester is verified using reasonable means proportionate to the risk of mis-identification before the request is actioned; the controller may request additional information necessary to confirm identity, and the verification scope is limited to the minimum information required (Art. 5(1)(c) minimisation), with a documented graduated-verification standard and proportionality justification per request class.
goals.adjustment: Restated for an 8-employee B2B SaaS controller handling low-volume rights requests from business customers and their end-users; graduated verification and minimisation register scaled to the company's data categories (customer account metadata, task data) and managed-cloud hosting context.

goals.goal: Identities, credentials, and access entitlements for product users, service identities, and integrated components of TinyTask's SaaS platform are managed in a verifiable manner throughout the product's operational lifetime, with type/batch/serial unique identification backing the identity register and a documented single point of contact for identity-related queries (Art. 13(17)).
goals.source: CRA Annex I Part I (2)(d); Art. 13(15); Art. 13(17); Annex II §3
goals.adjustment: Restated for an 8-employee manufacturer of a default-class B2B SaaS product; verifiable-manner obligation applied to the product's user accounts, internal service identities, and third-party integrated components (e.g., external payment provider); operational-lifetime scope aligned with the SaaS subscription model and self-assessment conformity path.
